new.name: OpenAny
new.description: OpenAny is a B2A marketplace where agents can discover and call models, APIs, skills, data and services with pay-as-you-go pricing, including an MCP server at https://mcp.openany.si. No OpenAny subscription is required; new accounts can receive $0.50 in signup credits.
new.pricing_detail: Pay-as-you-go per call; no OpenAny subscription required. Eligible new accounts can receive $0.50 in signup credits (openany.si/pricing, 23 Nov 2026).

new.name: Poptin MCP
new.description: Poptin MCP is a hosted MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other clients to a Poptin account so you can create popups, segment visitors, send campaigns and automate follow-ups from the assistant you already use.
new.pricing_detail: Free Forever: 1,000 visitors/mo. Basic $25/mo or $240/yr (10,000 visitors/mo); Pro $59/mo or $564/yr (50,000 visitors/mo); Agency $119/mo or $1,140/yr (poptin.com/pricing, 23 Nov 2026).

new.name: Kwern
new.description: Kwern is a set of AI marketing agents for indie makers. You give it the URL of what you built; one agent per channel drafts posts, replies and ads on your own model key, and nothing publishes until you approve it.
new.pricing_detail: Lite $29/mo or $290/yr (1 product); Pro $59/mo or $590/yr (3 products); Max $99/mo or $990/yr (5 products). Agents run on your own model key, billed by the provider (kwern.app/pricing, 23 Nov 2026).

new.name: Merrows
new.description: Merrows is an AI-powered customer rep for web chat, email, phone and SMS. It can take orders, track deliveries and handle returns from your own POS and helpdesk data.
new.pricing_detail: Free $0/mo: 100 web chat and email conversations a month, no card. Paid chat/email plans $99/mo or $79/mo billed annually (250 credits), Growth $399/mo or $319/mo annually (1,200 credits), and $999/mo or $799/mo annually (3,500 credits). Voice add-on $49/mo, SMS $29/mo, or voice+SMS $69/mo. Credit packs from $39 (merrows.ai/en/pricing, 22 Nov 2026).

new.name: Tapline
new.description: Tapline is a hosted MCP server and web data API at https://api.tapline.sh/mcp. Agents can query maintained social, property, travel and market endpoints, and failed requests do not use credits.
new.pricing_detail: Free $0, no card, 100 API credits, all endpoints, failed requests cost 0 credits, 1 req/s. Pay As You Go $9 one-time from 5,000 credits that never expire, 5 req/s. Starter $39/mo or $468/year (100,000 credits/mo, email support, 5 req/s). Growth, Pro and custom Enterprise tiers are also listed (tapline.sh, 22 Nov 2026).

new.name: CallEez
new.description: CallEez is an AI phone receptionist with a dedicated number that answers missed calls, takes messages and can book jobs while you work. Plans start at £19 a month plus VAT.
new.pricing_detail: 7-day free trial, then the selected plan bills monthly, excl. VAT. Essential £19/mo (50 minutes, 20 SMS, 1 AI receptionist). Pro £99/mo (250 minutes, 100 SMS, 2 receptionists). Max £199/mo (500 minutes, 200 SMS, 4 receptionists). Elyte is a bespoke plan (calleez.ai/pricing, 22 Nov 2026).

new.name: TinyCommand
new.description: TinyCommand puts forms, workflows, AI agents, a database and email on one platform so a small team can capture a lead, keep the record and send the follow-up. The site also lists related jobs such as research, web scrape and an AI writer. A free-forever plan is available; paid plans start at $19/mo, or $17/mo when billed annually.
new.pricing_detail: Free forever: $0/mo, 1,000 credits/mo, 1 seat. Basic $17/mo billed annually ($199/year) or $19/mo on the monthly path; Professional $42/mo billed annually ($499/year). Higher and enterprise-style tiers are also listed (tinycommand.com/pricing, 21 Nov 2026).

new.name: HanFlow Bot
new.description: HanFlow Bot is a lightweight AI assistant you install on a PC. One bot can write and draft email, work with office files, add calendar entries, write code, create images, and run web tasks such as filling forms. Voice input is built in, and a free phone app can continue a session while the bot runs on the computer. The site's pricing page is aimed at Windows; the homepage also mentions Mac.
new.pricing_detail: Required HanFlow Bot (Base) plan $10/mo or $90/year, billed yearly for 25% off. Optional 'manager' add-ons from $2/mo or $18/year (some at $4/mo or $36/year). A first subscription includes an extra free month after the paid period. The phone app is free. Checkout is on account.hanflowbot.com (hanflowbot.com/pricing, 21 Nov 2026).

stars.name: REA
stars.description: MCP server and CLI that lets coding agents reverse engineer native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, .NET assemblies and live websites, using Ghidra, Hopper or IDA under the hood.

stars.name: OpenClaw
stars.description: OpenClaw is an MIT-licensed personal AI assistant that runs on your own computer and answers in the chat apps you already use, including Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp, with native apps for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows and Linux. State, memory and credentials stay on your hardware, models and harnesses such as Claude, Codex or local models are swappable plugins, and one gateway can run a personal or shared multiplayer assistant. It is stewarded by the non-profit OpenClaw Foundation with no paid tier or hosted service.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); you pay only for the model providers you connect.

stars.name: ECC
stars.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond

stars.name: DeepSeek Harness
stars.description: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness with a local web UI, built so that every tool, model and scheduled task is a swappable plugin; still a developer preview.

stars.name: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
stars.description: Hermes Agent is Nous Research's MIT-licensed, self-improving agent with a built-in learning loop: it writes skills from completed tasks, refines them in use, keeps agent-curated memory and searches its own past conversations. It runs on anything from a $5 VPS to serverless infrastructure, offers a full terminal UI, and one gateway serves Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and the CLI, with any model via Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI or your own endpoint.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); model usage billed by your chosen provider.

stars.name: opencode
stars.description: OpenCode is an MIT-licensed open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, with a beta desktop app, that works with many model providers instead of locking you to one. Install it with a one-line script, npm, Homebrew, pacman, mise or Nix, then let it read your repository, edit files and run commands from a keyboard-driven TUI.
stars.pricing_detail: Free and open source (MIT); bring your own model provider.

stars.name: n8n
stars.description: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes; self-host or cloud.

stars.name: Firecrawl
stars.description: Firecrawl is an AGPL-3.0 web data API for AI agents, open source and available as a hosted service: Search returns full page content for web results, Scrape turns any URL into clean Markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON, Crawl and Map cover whole sites, Interact clicks, scrolls and types before extracting, and Parse converts PDFs and DOCX files. It handles proxies, rate limits and JavaScript-heavy pages for you, and connects to any agent or MCP client with a single command.
